meta.name: Valentín: La muerte del Gallo de Oro
meta.description: La serie documental explora algunas teorías alrededor de la muerte de "El Gallo de Oro" que quedaron marcadas por la violencia, el misterio y la ausencia de una verdad definitiva, así como el legado de un artista que sigue vigente en la memoria colectiva mexicana.

videos.title: Episodio 1
videos.overview: After a private show, popular singer Valentín Elizalde is killed in a violent shootout, leading authorities to investigate local cartels.

videos.title: Episodio 2
videos.overview: As news of Valentín's death spreads, those close to the singer begin to question whether the shootout's sole survivor was involved.

videos.title: Episodio 3
videos.overview: As thousands bid farewell to Valentín, his family continues to seek closure -- but, decades later, questions surrounding his death remain.
